newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch minister plans new El Al freighter probe.
newsitem.headline: Dutch minister plans new El Al freighter probe.

text.p: Dutch transport Minister Annemarie Jorritsma wants to launch a new investigation into the 1992 El Al freighter crash, after a television documentary screened in the Netherlands on Thursday, a government spokesman said on Friday.

Ton van Wijk told Reuters the transport minister wanted an investigation to answer questions posed by the NOVA documentary which featured two separate weigh bill documents, said to relate to flight TY1862, which crashed into an Amsterdam suburb in 1992 killing at least 42 people.

Van Wijk said the minister was likely to try to address the Dutch Tweede Kamer on the issue this afternoon, and is currently in talks with officials from Dutch Civil Aviation Authority on the subject.
The programme featured a report which showed that two weigh-bills were in circulation, which the documentary makers claimed had been provided by the Israeli national carrier.

There has been speculation that the two separate sets of papers show a discrepancy in the number of cargo lots on board the ill-fated freight liner. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
